newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 7.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Front-page story carries the full text of a speech delivered by Premier Li Peng last September on eliminating poverty by the end of the century.
Pre-tax profits of the China National Petrochemical Corp fell to 31.5 billion yuan ($3.8 billion) in 1996, down from 33.7 billion yuan ($4.1 billion) in 1995.
China's oil output is seen at 165-167 million tonnes in 1997, up 4.2-5.5 percent from 1996.
The State Planning Commission says controlling inflation is one of the main tasks in 1997.
The production value of China's chemical industry is estimated to have grown 9.7 percent in 1996 to more than 252 billion yuan ($30.4 billion).
